diagram_math_checks.evidence: Remarks defines D^k(X)=H_dR^k(X), S^k(X)=H_infty^k(X;R), and the ordered U,V direct sums. Each row has exactly the five terms in proof step 1.1: degree q-1 direct sum, degree q-1 overlap, degree q on M, degree q direct sum, degree q overlap. All five vertical integration arrows have matching degrees and spaces, with direct-sum arrows at columns one and four.

The two s arrows per row are V-minus-U restrictions, from the ordered direct sum to W. The r arrow restricts from M to the ordered direct sum. Delta has degree +1 from W to M, with positive lift-differential sign. F1 supplier Statement and proof 1.2 specify V-U; F2 supplier Statement and proof 1.1–3.1 specify the same positive connector and lift (-rho_V omega,rho_U omega), not a negated connector.

Squares one and four are I_W s_D = s_S(I_U plus I_V), at degrees q-1 and q respectively, by F1 proof 1.2 and item step 1.1. Square two is I_M Delta_D=Delta_S I_W, exactly F2 Statement and proof 5.1. Square three is (I_U plus I_V)r_D=r_S I_M, by F1 proof 1.1 and item step 1.1. Thus every displayed square uses the actual integration maps, including the small-chain identification discussed in F1 proof 2.1.

Both rows are exact by the already cited F5/F6 and item step 1.1. Step 2.1 proves columns one, two, four and five are isomorphisms from the given hypotheses. Step 3.1 handles q=0 by zero negative-degree groups. No additional choice or new isomorphism hypothesis is asserted by the illustration.
The original Statement, Facts and four proof steps are byte-unchanged; the final paragraph expressly states the diagram illustrates the independently complete proof.
